description: Prudential Financial, Inc. and its subsidiaries provide a wide range of insurance, investment management and other financial products and services to both individual and institutional customers throughout the United States and in many other countries, with principal products and services including life insurance, annuities, retirement solutions, mutual funds and investment management. Its principal operations consist of PGIM, its global investment management business, the U.S. Businesses consisting of the Retirement Strategies, Group Insurance and Individual Life businesses, the International Businesses, the Closed Block division, and its Corporate and Other operations, and the Closed Block division is accounted for as a divested business that is reported separately from the Divested and Run-off Businesses included within Corporate and Other operations.
